_note: Weight register. Each item has a mass in tonnes only when there is a source for it. mass_t null means unknown, and an unknown item is never counted as zero. mass_status is one of: unknown, placeholder (a stated assumption for review), sourced (taken from a named document). The validator reports coverage, so a short total cannot pass as a complete one.
reference_source: README.md: canoe-body approximation, 786.3 m³ × 1.025 t/m³ ≈ 806 t. Not a verified lightship or full-load mass.
